text.text_excerpt: I am in love with this place! Seriously, the food is mind blowing: very fresh, delicious and different for NOLA. The fish dishes in particular blew me away. I HIGHLY recommended. Service: they have an amazing wait staff! The bartender was so sweet and very accommodating -- once we sat down she even noticed we were trying to take a picture and ran over to take it for us. Our waitress was very friendly, explained everything very well and was just an absolutely delight throughout the meal. Service is definitely one of those things I forget about at restaurants, but the hospitality here really made the meal even better. Okay into the food: I seriously don't think you can go wrong here. I went...

My husband and I attended the soft opening for the restaurant today, and I wanted to be the first person to tell the world how amazing this place is! We tried the octopus, red pepper and feta spread, and the brussel sprouts for starters. The octopus was tender and the sprouts were to die for-- crispy and full of flavor. I ordered the fish of the day, my husband got souvlaki, and his friend got the fried porkchop. The fish and souvlaki were very good, and the pork chop was absolutely huge. The craft cocktails looked inventive and sounded tasty, but we couldn't drink because we had to drive. I'm excited to go back sometime for a few cocktails...and definitely for the brussel sprouts.

Had dinner here last night (12/28/19). Really impressed. This place needs to be busier. All of the food was lovely, the service was spot on and very helpful. We started with the plate of spreads. The red pepper spread was particularly nice, the tzatziki was nice and lemony. I had a delicious salad with pecans and pomegranate seeds and shaved apples. Nice and fresh and crunchy. I paired that with lamb flatbread, the crust of which was really nice. We finished with baklava. So good. My companions had the pork chop (which is huge and SO good) and the whole fish. We were really impressed with the whole thing. These folks deserve to be very successful.
